weights: No universal fixed weights; qualitative anchor calibration only

creative.definition: Quality of content expression: attention, delivery, payoff, cohesion, cultural comprehension where relevant

anchors.0-2: Incoherent or no identifiable viewing reason
anchors.3-4: Limited interest; weak execution, payoffs or coherence
anchors.5-6: Some effective mechanism and watch value, material execution weakness
anchors.7-8: Clear, well-executed appeal and content reward
anchors.9-10: Exceptional execution/impact with clear evidence of sustained viewing incentives

registration_potential.definition: How compellingly the content connects felt desire to personally plausible Popup experience

anchors.0-2: No defensible reason to download Popup from the content
anchors.5-6: App use case is understood but weak personal reason to try
anchors.7-8: Concrete product-linked user desire and plausible experience
anchors.9-10: Exceptionally clear, credible, sustained product desire, with strong evidence in the creative

rules: Scores are independent and determined before outcomes are revealed
Do not reward trend, local slang, originality or reverse automatically
Reverse absent may be N/A; not zero
Use null when key media or linguistic evidence is unavailable
Provide timestamps/panel references and confidence for each rating
Do not report numeric predictions as statistically validated probabilities

expert_priority_notes.reverse: Expert subjective emphasis approximately 70% when central to narrative and motivation; not a model coefficient
expert_priority_notes.experience_credibility: Expert subjective emphasis approximately 70%; staging can remain plausible; not factual authenticity
